description: Loss statistics for one attachment/detachment tranche over a simulated pool loss distribution.

attachment.description: Tranche attachment point as a fraction of pool notional, in `[0, 1)`.

detachment.description: Tranche detachment point as a fraction of pool notional, in `(0, 1]`.

expected_loss_amount.description: Mean tranche loss in pool-notional units.

expected_loss_fraction.description: Mean tranche loss as a fraction of tranche notional, in `[0, 1]`.

expected_shortfall_amount.description: Probability-weighted mean tranche loss amount in the worst confidence tail.

expected_shortfall_fraction.description: Probability-weighted mean tranche loss fraction in the worst confidence tail.

prob_attachment_breached.description: Share of paths whose pool loss fraction strictly exceeds `attachment`.

prob_full_writedown.description: Share of paths whose pool loss fraction reaches or exceeds `detachment`.

var_amount.description: Nearest-rank tranche loss amount at the distribution's confidence.

var_fraction.description: Nearest-rank tranche loss fraction at the distribution's confidence.

title: TrancheLossStatistics
